newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGUESE SHARES TO WEAKEN AS EUROPE RETREATS.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGUESE SHARES TO WEAKEN AS EUROPE RETREATS.

text.p: 0825 GMT - Shares were likely to weaken after Europe generally retreated in response to Wall Street's 1.26 percent drop on Tuesday, traders said.
*"We have been following Wall Street and seeing as how it fell yesterday, we will have to nowhere else to go," said one trader.
*The market will also be keeping a close eye on the U.S. producer price figures to be released at 1230 GMT today.
*Madrid was losing 0.94 percent, London 0.54 percent and Paris 1.25 percent.
